QUOTE: A multi-token query can come back empty even when each token occurs in the repository, because matching requires every token to appear in one searchable unit. In this case `not_searched=3` and `empty=204` both matched, but no single symbol carried both.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never says that a single-token miss was previously treated as proof of absence; it discusses multi-token conjunction misses and coverage but not that earlier-behavior mistake.
